description: Chatbot evaluation set (section 3.5.1): 100 questions, 50 English and 50 Bisaya, 4 per inquiry category, written by the researchers as new wordings — none is copied from the agent's training phrases (scripts/evaluate-chatbot.mjs checks). `expected` lists the intent(s) whose answer is correct for the question; the first is the main one.

conversationsNote: A follow-up is labelled with the intent the server answers it with: the server turns the agent's follow-up intents into the main intent of the thread (resolveBusinessFollowup, resolveCivilFollowup), e.g. "how much?" after a business permit answer becomes permit.business.fees.inquire, and after a birth registration answer the LCRO fee list (civil.registry.fees.inquire).
